description: A component-body handler whose `!{}` guard ARM reads a prop (RT). Clicking runs the .Empty arm with the prop substituted: @r = 9. Before the S440 final round, the component expander substituted props into the guarded call only, never into the arms, so the arm's `n` stayed unbound and the compile failed with E-SCOPE-001.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S439 #14 + S440 "all recs" (restore conformance); review:S440-final-round-N2
rationale: §19.4.3 — a handler handles a failable call with `!{}`, and a component body's handler is no exception. A prop read inside an arm is a prop reference like any other (§15 component props), so it is substituted.
